alignment.time_matching: exact timestamps; compare the same scored samples

baseflow_initialization.bounds: clip each filtered baseflow to [0, observed discharge]
baseflow_initialization.initial_baseflow: first observed discharge in each independent input series

evaluation.causality: Performance metrics do not establish causal attribution
evaluation.event_segmentation: For analysis-001/002, use the supplied event_parameters on observed discharge and basin rainfall, not arbitrary calendar windows.

extracted_event_ids: Integer IDs 1,2,... in chronological extracted-event order, independently within each observation window.

forcing_selection.evaporation_rule: retain E0 as E0; the authorised PET mapping is not used by this task
forcing_selection.standardised_forcing_schema: time,source_id,variable,depth_mm; emit only the declared source IDs, not other available stations

implementation_choices: diagnosis and retry within the resource budget

dhf.semantics: Run the first 12 forcing rows from these states, then propagate the resulting states over the remaining rows; exclude warmup rows from scoring, with no post-warmup override.

gr4j.semantics: Propagate states over all daily forcing rows; exclude the first two days from scoring.

model_initialization.lumped_xaj: Use WUM_init/WLM_init/WDM_init/S1/FR1/Q in lumped_parameters; propagate continuous states, reset to those values for each independent event.
model_initialization.semi_xaj: Use semi_parameters.initial, semi_parameters.warmup_steps and semi_parameters.simulation; only that supplied initial-state block selects the semi model states.

notice: 明确声明的测试场景设定，补充数据不是实测修复。来源清单中的原始空白始终保留；supplements 逐项标注合成值。
routing_initialization: For each independent input series, initial routed flow equals its first inflow value; no state carryover between events.

spatial_processing.station_aggregation: Thiessen polygon area weights clipped to each target unit

task_science.active_forward_model: none; preprocessing or existing-result analysis only
task_science.external_inflow: Only use external inflow when this task has an external_inflow declaration; other available release columns do not authorize injection.
task_science.parameter_scope: Use only the model named here. Other supplied model parameter blocks are contextual and do not select an additional model.
task_science.semi_model_parameters: semi_parameters; internal channel routing uses xaj.KE, xaj.XE and time.step_seconds inside this block

time.output_rule: Localise naive source timestamps to Asia/Shanghai; every output time/start/end/peak timestamp must include an explicit offset. UTC Z and +08:00 denote equivalent instants.

*_rain.semantics: station precipitation depth; source IDs match stations.csv

E0.semantics: benchmark-declared evaporation forcing; PET mapping above is explicitly authorised

GB_out.semantics: upstream reservoir release; used only where external_inflow is specified
